mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT S.ID, S.MASTER_ID, S.NAME, S.DESCRIPTION, S.TYPE, S.SUB_ID, S.LEVEL, S.FID, S.ALIAS_SUB_ID, S.ORDER, S.SUB_IMG_ID, S.STATE, S.TOKEN, S.IS_PUBLIC, S.UPDATE_TIME, S.CREATE_TIME, S.INTRO_ON_OFF, S.TEMPLATE_ID, F.ID AS F_ID, F.NAME AS F_NAME, F.FILE_URL AS F_FILE_URL, F.SAVE_TYPE AS F_SAVE_TYPE FROM GC_SUBJECT S LEFT JOIN SYS_FILE F ON F.ID = S.SUB_IMG_ID LEFT JOIN gc_video v ON v.sub_id= s.id where s.state !=0 and s.fid =#{fid} order by S.order asc,s.create_time asc,s.id

select S.ID, SUM(F.VIDEO_LONG) as "subjectVideoDuration" FROM GC_SUBJECT S LEFT JOIN GC_SUBJECT S0 ON S0.FID=S.ID LEFT JOIN GC_VIDEO V ON V.SUB_ID = S0.ID LEFT JOIN SYS_FILE F ON F.ID = V.FILE_ID WHERE f.video_long >= 0
and S.ID IN
#{id}
GROUP BY S.ID

SELECT DISTINCT ON (s.id) S.ID, S.MASTER_ID, S.NAME, S.DESCRIPTION, S.TYPE, S.SUB_ID, S.LEVEL, S.FID, S.ALIAS_SUB_ID, S.ORDER, S.SUB_IMG_ID, S.STATE, S.TOKEN, S.IS_PUBLIC, S.UPDATE_TIME, S.CREATE_TIME, S.INTRO_ON_OFF, S.TEMPLATE_ID, F.ID AS F_ID, F.NAME AS F_NAME, F.FILE_URL AS F_FILE_URL, F.SAVE_TYPE AS F_SAVE_TYPE, f.thumb_nail_url as thumb_nail_url, (SELECT count( 1 ) FROM gc_video WHERE sub_id = s.id) AS videos_total_num FROM GC_SUBJECT S LEFT JOIN gc_content_group_course_assignment course_assignment ON course_assignment.course_id = s.id LEFT JOIN gc_access content_group ON course_assignment.content_group_id = content_group.id LEFT JOIN gc_user_access ua ON UA.access_id = content_group.id LEFT JOIN GC_USER "user" ON "user".ID = ua.USER_ID LEFT JOIN gc_video v ON v.sub_id= s.id left join sys_file f on v.file_id = f.id
s.state !=0
AND s.id in
#{subjectId}

select g.fid,g.id,count(1)as videos_total_num from gc_subject g LEFT JOIN gc_video v on v.sub_id = g.id where 1=1
AND g.id in
#{subjectId}
group by g.id

select * from gc_subject
AND sub_id in
#{subId}
order by "order"

SELECT * from gc_subject s left join gc_video v on v.sub_id=s.id where v.id in
#{vid}

SELECT s.*,F.ID AS F_ID, F.NAME AS F_NAME, F.FILE_URL AS F_FILE_URL, F.SAVE_TYPE AS F_SAVE_TYPE from gc_subject s left join sys_file f on f.id = s.sub_img_id where s.id in
#{id}
